hypothesis: Two Gradle processes concurrently rewrote or consumed shared module build outputs; the missing foundation package was a build-output race, not a source or dependency declaration defect.
counterexamples: Foundation focused test completed successfully in the same worktree.

No Java source was changed between the failed interceptor task and the successful compile.
smallestRemedy: Serialize Gradle invocations that share the workspace build tree; do not increase timeout or add a dependency fallback.
